Subject: Trouble completing Zip invite — reCAPTCHA keeps spinning behind corp proxy

Hi Marcus / Laura,

We're trying to finish our vendor setup in Zip for ClearMotive but two things are blocking us:

- After clicking the invite link we hit the reCAPTCHA challenge which then never completes (spinning indicator).
- If we try to bypass with our corp proxy disabled it works, but we can't ask procurement to change proxy rules.

I've attached a quick screenshot and the redirect headers from the invite click. The browser shows a 302 -> internal proxy auth page, then a 200 with the reCAPTCHA widget, and then an XHR that times out.

This is blocking our PO intake for the week — can you advise whether Zip supports a proxy-friendly invite flow or an alternate SSO redirect?

Thanks,
Amanda

Hi Marcus / Amanda,

I've gone through the header dump. A few findings:
- The invite link performs a short series of redirects: our CDN -> zip's invite handler -> zip-auth, then a client-side script that loads recaptcha.js from google.
- ClearMotive's proxy is inserting an X-Proxy-Auth header and rewriting Set-Cookie for one of the intermediate responses; that generally breaks the reCAPTCHA flow (widget relies on same-origin cookies and an unmodified payload).

Proposed mitigations:
1) Short-term: use the "Sign in with SSO" option instead of the invite flow (if ClearMotive can accept an SP-initiated SAML redirect). Sends a direct SAML handshake rather than the invite widget.
2) If SSO is not an option, Zip support can issue an invite token that bypasses the client reCAPTCHA for 24 hours for a one-time use. We have done this previously for enterprise customers.

Amanda: I attached a tiny test harness (zip-invite-headers.txt) and a suggested curl command you can run from inside your network to capture the exact flow. Also please try incognito as Marcus suggested — often extensions or cached cookies from the proxy portal cause the infinite spinner.

I'll also open ONB-5821 in Jira to track an engineering workaround for proxies that inject headers.

Ben Carter
Sr. Systems Engineer, Customer Infra | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
